verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a self-service transfer for moving existing CRM data into HubSpot. It also offers a multi-object import that brings in companies, deals and activities like calls or meetings, with associations between them. Records and some history are covered, but nothing shows owner assignments carrying over or that full history migrates intact. Missing for 10: evidence that record owners are preserved, detail on the scope of history and timeline migration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a CRM-to-CRM migration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate from another CRM with my records, owners, and history intact

citations.quote: If you're new to HubSpot and want to transfer your existing CRM data to HubSpot's CRM, you can use self-service transfer to audit and sync your data
You can import records such as companies or deals, as well as activities like calls or meetings, and create associations between them.
